title: Resident Onboarding Wizard
subtitle: Complete tenant registration, room & bed slot allocation, lease agreement, and initial dues collection.

step1.heading: Personal & Emergency Info
step1.subheading: Enter the new resident's legal contact and emergency details.

step2.heading: Select Property & Room Allocation
step2.subheading: Pick an available bed slot across your active properties and buildings.
step2.noRooms: No rooms or beds available for the selected building/floor.
step2.selectBedAlert: Please select an available bed to continue.

step3.heading: Lease Agreement & Contract Rates
step3.subheading: Configure lease duration, food plans, contracted rent rate, and security deposit.
step3.errAmount: Enter valid amounts for the rent and the security deposit.
step3.agreedRentHint: Set by the room's rate for the chosen food plan. Discounts are added separately.

step4.heading: Initial Dues & Payment Method
step4.subheading: Enter what the resident pays now. Anything left can be paid later.
step4.pendingNote: Unpaid rent stays on the first invoice; extra advance paid now is held for later invoices or exit refund. Unpaid deposit can be recorded later from the resident's profile.
step4.estimatedAdvanceLabel: Estimated advance remaining after first invoice
step4.estimatedAdvanceNote: Estimate based on agreed monthly rent — the actual first invoice may differ due to proration or discounts. Once issued, the exact held advance balance is shown on the resident's profile.
step4.errInvalidAmount: Enter a valid amount (up to 2 decimals).
step4.errRentExceeds: This is more than the agreed rent.
step4.errDepositExceeds: This is more than the agreed deposit.
step4.errDate: Choose today or an earlier date.

controls.successSub: The resident profile has been created and assigned to the selected bed slot.
